summary: Iteration 107: Inventory Relation Lookup Fix - All 12 backend tests passed (100%). The fix correctly changes relation-lookup for inventory to query sellerListings with $lookup to products instead of querying products directly.

frontend_issues.notes: Backend-only testing as requested. Frontend not tested.

critical_code_review_comments: ✓ relation_lookup endpoint now uses aggregation pipeline on sellerListings with $lookup to products
✓ Pipeline: $match sellerId + status -> $lookup products on productId -> $unwind -> $project listingId, productName, sku
✓ Search filtering works on productName (from $lookup) and sku (from sellerListings)
✓ validate_record_data now validates inventory relations against sellerListings collection
✓ resolve_relation_display now resolves inventory items from sellerListings joined with products
✓ Response format correct: {results: [{id: listingId, label: productName, sub: sku}]}
✓ Invoices relation lookup still works correctly (not affected by fix)
✓ Invalid inventory relation IDs correctly rejected with 400 error

context_for_next_testing_agent: Iteration 107 verified the inventory relation-lookup fix. The fix changes three places in panel_router.py: (1) relation_lookup endpoint now uses aggregation on sellerListings with $lookup to products, (2) validate_record_data checks sellerListings for inventory validation, (3) resolve_relation_display resolves from sellerListings joined with products. All tests pass. The inventory system uses sellerListings as the source of truth, not products directly.
